name: Hierarchical Trilinear Ray Casting
aliases: Adaptive ray casting using trilinear basis functions
Hierarchical Data Structures for Ray Casting
Hierarchical Ray Casting with Trilinear Coefficients
Hierarchically Accelerated Ray Casting with Controlled Error
definition: A volume rendering technique that uses a hierarchical data structure to accelerate ray casting. It approximates data regions using least-squares trilinear coefficients to decide whether to refine the ray traversal or evaluate the data directly.
summary: Hierarchical Trilinear Ray Casting accelerates volume rendering by using trilinear approximations and error tolerance to adaptively refine ray traversal, unlike standard fixed-step methods.
